m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read crew context, glossary, handoff, baseline evidence. Verify handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: Crew context + handoff loaded; handoff complete; baseline numbers noted

m1-write-script.title: Write scripts/scope_quali_anchor_414.py
m1-write-script.imperative: Write the measurement script: imports sp/dqe, reads 414 records, implements C1/C2/C3 candidates, sweeps alpha, enforces alpha=0/alpha=1 endpoint pins, --check-baseline flag, table output, JSON evidence write. DO NOT modify sp or dqe. NO production code changes.

postconditions.statement: scripts/scope_quali_anchor_414.py exists and is syntactically valid

constraints: DB-only; stdlib+numpy; reuse sp/dqe; no production changes; no forking ceiling math

m2-write-tests.title: Write tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_scope_quali_anchor_414.py
m2-write-tests.imperative: Write 4 tests: (a) C1/C2 alpha=0 reproduce baseline; (b) C1 alpha=1 equals ceiling; (c) C3 monotone transform is no-op; (d) shared-pairs invariant holds. Use real 414 records. Fast/deterministic.

postconditions.statement: test file exists and is syntactically valid

constraints: Use real 414 records; deterministic; no production changes

m3-run-tests.title: Run tests and confirm all pass
m3-run-tests.imperative: Run py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_scope_quali_anchor_414.py -q and confirm all 4 tests pass.

m4-run-script.title: Run full script and capture evidence
m4-run-script.imperative: Run the script with the 414 records dir, capture stdout to .agent-work/issue-414-quali-head-scoping/evidence/g2_scope_run.txt. Confirm scope_anchor_numbers.json is written.

m5-check-baseline.title: Run --check-baseline and confirm exit 0
m5-check-baseline.imperative: Run py scripts/scope_quali_anchor_414.py --check-baseline (with RECORDS_DIR set). Confirm exit 0, alpha=0 reproduces baseline within tolerance.
